stacktrace-refund-500.alt: Spring Boot stack trace for a refund 500
stacktrace-refund-500.description: NullPointerException at com.northwind.payments.RefundService.refund(RefundService.java:42). Payment is null before refund is called. HTTP 500 on POST /payments/{id}/refunds.
stacktrace-refund-500.answer: RefundService.refund throws NPE at line 42 because Payment is null. Load the payment before calling refund; the HTTP 500 is that NPE.

auth-401-screenshot.alt: HTTP 401 response from the payments API
auth-401-screenshot.description: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized. WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. Body: {"error":"missing_token"}. The client called GET /payments without an Authorization header.
auth-401-screenshot.answer: 401 missing_token: send Authorization: Bearer <token>. The screenshot shows no Authorization header.
